description: DUT receives an MSS option in a SYN,ACK and clamps the effective send segment size to min(advertised, DUT_MSS) (RFC 1122 §4.2.2.5 p85). Iterations: Mv=200 (smaller), Mv=2000 (larger)
approach:
[Objective]
Mirror of MSS_OPTIONS_06 from the active-OPEN side: DUT learns peer's MSS from the SYN,ACK in SYN-SENT.

[Scenario — chronological]
Two phases — DUT active OPEN; tester replies SYN,ACK with MSS Mv ∈ {200, 2000}; DUT subsequent data segments observed.

[Pass condition]
Phase 1 size ≤ 200; phase 2 size = DUT_MSS (1460).

[Fail condition]
Per phase: Fail_wrong_size_phase<n> or Fail_timeout_phase<n>.

verdicts.Pass: DUT clamped send size from SYN,ACK MSS — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_size_phase1: Phase 1 segment size not advertised MSS 200
verdicts.Fail_wrong_size_phase2: Phase 2 segment size not DUT MSS 1460
verdicts.Fail_timeout_phase1: No DUT data segment phase 1 Mv=200
verdicts.Fail_timeout_phase2: No DUT data segment phase 2 Mv=2000
